rolling_mad.limitations: STATISTICAL POWER LIMITATION: The benchmark evaluation dataset contains a small number of injected surge events (typically 3 events across 9 positive days). Metrics such as Precision, Recall, and F1 have wide binomial uncertainty. These scores demonstrate relative algorithmic behavior under synthetic benchmark conditions; they DO NOT establish real-world clinical sensitivity, diagnostic efficacy, or regulatory readiness.
